parts.t: STUNNING 5 bed, 4 bath home with 2,556 sq ft in prestigious Grandview Heights. Natural light floods the soaring 10-ft ceilings, showcasing the airy open-concept layout. Gourmet kitchen, generous living and dining spaces, plus a dedicated main floor office. Host effortlessly on the expansive covered deck with cozy outdoor fireside lounge. Upper level boasts a vaulted primary sanctuary and 2 more bedrooms. Lower level includes a 1-bedroom suite with private entry and an additional bedroom. Detached double garage with EV rough-in plus bonus parking pad. Walk to Edgewood Elementary, Grandview Heights Secondary, Morgan Crossing, dining and Grandview Aquatic Centre. This is the one you’ve been waiting for!  Accepted Offer Until June 16th
